meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找出之前会话的解法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从过往会话中找回解法与结论
copy.tagline_en: Search past sessions for prior solutions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to dig up past session solutions and decisions

howto.what: 启用后,当用户提起以前会话做过的事,Claude 会先搜索持久记忆库,返回带编号的摘要列表;再查看时间线筛出相关条目;最后只读取选中的几条完整记录,据此回答。搜索、筛选、读取三步依次进行。
howto.when: 当用户问起之前的会话(不是当前对话),例如“我们是不是已经修过这个?”、“上次是怎么解决 X 的?”、“上周发生了什么?”等。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么解决登录超时的?
say.note: 会先列出相关历史记录摘要,再读取详情回答。

say.text: 搜一下之前关于认证的 bug 修复记录。
say.note: 会按类型筛选,再批量读取完整内容。

say.text: 查查上周我们讨论过什么?
say.note: 会按日期范围搜索,返回摘要列表。

howto.what_en: When the user asks about past work, Claude searches the persistent memory database, shows a table of matching entries with IDs and titles, reviews the timeline to filter relevant items, then fetches full details only for selected IDs before answering.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user refers to previous sessions, e.g. asking 'did we already fix this?', 'how did we solve X last time?', or 'what happened last week?'.

say_en.text: How did we fix the login timeout last time?
say_en.note: Lists matching history entries first, then reads details to answer.

say_en.text: Search for past bug fixes about authentication.
say_en.note: Filters by type, then fetches full records in a batch.

say_en.text: What did we discuss last week?
say_en.note: Searches by date range and returns a summary list.
